{{Quote|Stay there. I'll get the bomb squad.|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="TCWVirus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Clone ordnance specialists''', also known as '''bomb squad troopers''', were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], trained in both basic blaster and thinking skills and [[Bomb/Legends|ordnance]] disarmament and disposal. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], four bomb [[Squad/Legends|squad]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were deployed on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] discovered a secret [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], where the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] had built dozens of [[Viral bomb/Legends|bombs]] that would release an airborne version of the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. The bomb squad troopers, alongside several standard [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|attacked]] the Separatist laboratory to disable the virus bombs and free a pair of prisoners. During the resulting battle, Vindi activated the virus bombs, but the bomb squad troopers managed to deactivate them before they could detonate, while Skywalker and Kenobi captured Vindi. As the bomb troopers were guarding the captured bomb store, [[LEP-86C8/Legends|Vindi's assistant droid]] sneaked past the guards and reactivated a bomb, causing the explosive to detonate and leak the Blue Shadow Virus throughout the laboratory. However, Skywalker and Kenobi were able to find a cure on the planet [[Iego/Legends|Iego]].

==Characteristics==
Clone ordnance specialists<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], trained to disarm and dispose of [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] and explosive devices.<ref name="TCWVirus" /> This was often considered one of the most dangerous jobs in the army and required a gentle touch, steady nerves, well-trained dexterity, and a sense of how machines work from the troopers.<ref name="CE" /> The troopers served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCWVirus" /> Besides deactivating bombs, bomb squad members would also safeguard stores of disabled bombs in hostile conditions, such as during the middle of a battle.<ref name="TCWMoons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> Bomb squad troopers wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase I clone trooper armor]], customized with orange marking<ref name="TCWVirus" /> and an insignia on the left shoulder<ref name="CE" /> to signify their bomb disposal role.<ref name="TCWVirus" />

==History==
[[File:Bombsquad2.png|thumb|left|200px|A Bomb Squad trooper disarming virus bombs]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] discovered a [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|secret laboratory]] in the [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where Confederate [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] had created an airborne version of the [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. Shortly after sending a message to [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Security]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], Amidala and Binks were captured by the Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, when Amidala and Binks disappeared, Captain Typho alerted the Republic about the situation on Naboo, and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to rescue Amidala and destroy the Blue Shadow Virus. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] took several clone troopers of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] with them, as well as four bomb squad troopers.<ref name="TCWVirus" />

Aboard several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transports]], the Jedi's strike team arrived at the eastern swamps, searching for the missing Amidala and Binks. Upon discovering Vindi's laboratory, the Republic forces [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|attacked]]. While Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]&mdash;along with the clone troopers and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]&mdash;distracted the battle droids, Skywalker left to rescue Amidala and Binks. The Republic strategy was successful: The bomb [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] and Kenobi reached the room and found the [[Viral bomb/Legends|virus bombs]] deactivated. However, at the moment when the troopers arrived in the bomb inventory, all the bombs were activated by the fleeing Vindi.

While Kenobi left the inventory to help Skywalker in the capturing of Vindi, the clones began disarming the bombs. After the scientist's capture, one virus bomb was taken by Vindi's private [[LEP-86C8/Legends|droid]], however, Senator Amidala managed to find the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and recover the bomb. After taking the virus bomb, Tano left Amidala to alert the bomb squad troopers. The bomb squad successfully disarmed the bombs before Vindi remotely detonated it.<ref name="TCWVirus" />

[[File:Virus_bomb.png|thumb|right|200px|A Bomb squad trooper with a disarmed virus bomb]]
However, one bomb squad trooper found out that a Blue Shadow Virus vial inside a bomb had been removed. Vindi's assistant droid inserted the vial in a bomb and detonated it, spreading the Blue Shadow Virus in the laboratory. Skywalker and Kenobi, who were outside of the laboratory when the explosion occurred, obtained a cure for the virus on the planet of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]].<ref name="TCWMoons" />

==Equipment==
Bomb squad troopers carried [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]] with them as protection.<ref name="TCWVirus" /> As a sidearm, they also were equipped with [[DC-15A blaster carbine|DC-15A blaster carbines]] as well as explosive sensors, ion probes and defusing tools<ref name="CE" /> like wire cutters to slice the detonators of bombs. This tool was used to great effect on Naboo, as bomb squad troopers disabled dozens of virus bombs with their cutters.<ref name="TCWVirus" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bomb_Squad_Trooper_concept.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Concept art for the Bomb Squad Troopers]]
Bomb squad troopers first appeared in "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]," the seventeenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The bomb squad troopers later appeared in the eighteenth episode, "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]."<ref name="TCWVirus" /><ref name="TCWMoons" />

In the "Blue Shadow Virus" commentary, series Director [[Dave Filoni]] stated because of production reasons and limited resources while creating the episode, a unique suit of armor for the Bomb Squad was unable to be used. This was due to the fact that there were many new characters in the episode and for production reasons they decided to use the standard armor.<ref name="NA">{{SW|url=video/blue-shadow-virus-episode-featurette|text="Blue Shadow Virus" Episode Featurette}}</ref> Their name was first revealed in the entry in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia|''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia'']].

Two Clone ordnance specialists along with an ARF trooper, and a [[Horn Company]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] were included in the [[2011]] [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] Clone Trooper Battle Pack.
